Interface NostrKey

All Superinterfaces:
Cloneable, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
NostrPrivateKey, NostrPublicKey
public interface NostrKey extends Serializable, Cloneable
Represents a private or public key in the Nostr protocol. This interface provides methods to obtain different representations of the key.

    • asHex

      String asHex()
      Returns the hex string representation of the key. This representation is lazily generated and cached after the first call. Use preload() if you want to generate the representation in advance.
      Returns:
      the hex string representation of the key

    • asReadOnlyBuffer

      ByteBuffer asReadOnlyBuffer()
      Returns an independent read-only view of the key's internal buffer.

      The returned view has its own position and limit. If the key is backed by direct memory, the view remains direct.

    • _array

      byte[] _array()
      Returns the internal bytes representation of the key. WARNING: do not modify the returned array to avoid unexpected behaviors, use asReadOnlyBytes whenever possible to avoid this issue.
      Returns:
      the internal bytes representation of the key that should be treated as immutable

    • preload

      void preload()
      Preloads the key representations in various formats. This method is useful when you want to generate the representations in advance for performance reasons.
